notes.title: Important optimization, level reset
notes.content:
1. Optimized the highway and outdoor checkpoints
2. Optimized the lighting, now there is also a better experience in medium and low image quality
3. Reset the jumping music level, now you can pass the level better, and you can also use the safety exit to enter the next level
4. Some fixes and optimizations
